info.title: rvtio
info.description: Command line tool that reads Autodesk Revit files (.rvt, .rfa) without Revit and writes IFC or JSON.

options.name: --json-full
options.description: write the full JSON dump (every parameter and the geometry) instead of the compact JSON

options.name: --compact-json
options.description: write the compact JSON, which is the default for a JSON output

options.name: --json-class-prefix
options.description: text put in front of the class names in the compact JSON "name" field

options.name: --ifc-profile
options.description: IFC output profile (default: current)

options.name: --ifc-revit-parameters
options.description: write the Revit parameters as IFC property sets

options.name: --ifc-revit-parameter-groups
options.description: write them as one property set per parameter group (implies --ifc-revit-parameters)

options.name: --ifc-no-base-quantities
options.description: leave out the base quantity sets

options.name: --ifc-room-phase
options.description: rooms to export: the last phase, every phase or one positive native phase id (IFC only)

options.name: --revit-localization
options.description: read the system family names from the resource DLLs of a Revit installation

options.name: --r22-layout
options.description: read the Revit 2022 layout for a JSON export too (an IFC export does it by default)

options.name: --no-r22-layout
options.description:
keep the 64-bit schema path alone in an IFC export
Report options (read the file and print or write a report instead of exporting):

options.name: --api-demo
options.description: print a tour of the document API

options.name: --inspect
options.description: print identity, parameters and geometry counts of elements

options.name: --diag-dump
options.description: hex dump of the blocks of elements

options.name: --find-str
options.description: find a UTF-16 text in the decompressed partition chunks

options.name: --sketch-owner-dump
options.description: write the closed sketch loops of every sketch-owning element

options.name: --inspect-batch
options.description: inspect many ids in one pass (ids: one per line or comma separated)

options.name: --list-category
options.description:
list the elements of one category
Developer options (measurement and comparison dumps, not a stable interface):

options.name: --dev-external-dump
options.description: text dump of the model for CompoundStructure layers

options.name: --dev-external-dump-prefix
options.description: class name prefix in that dump

options.name: --dev-candidates
options.description: compact JSON: write every listed parameter before the value gate

options.name: --dev-trace
options.description: compact JSON: write why each listed parameter was written or dropped

options.name: --dev-facts
options.description: compact JSON: write the facts that decide the phase parameters

options.name: --dev-fact-names
options.description: extra facts for --dev-facts

options.name: --dev-user-params
options.description: compact JSON: write the parameter definitions of the file

options.name: --dev-collisions
options.description: compact JSON: write user parameters that share a group and label

options.name: --dev-solids
options.description: compact JSON: write the solid quantities; with --dev-solids-only stop after it

options.name: --dev-native
options.description: compact JSON: print the native record of elements

options.name: --schema-dump
options.description: (first argument) write the class schema embedded in a file

options.name: --schema-check
options.description: (first argument) validate a class schema

options.name: --schema-diff
options.description: (first argument) compare two class schemas

options.name: --rebar-dump
options.description: (first argument) dump rebar records

options.name: --parse-block
options.description: (first argument) decode raw geometry block files

options.name: --elemtable-diag
options.description: [--sweep n] [--pin1 n] [--force idx:delta,...] [--dump-partial]

options.name: --class-census
options.description: --episode-check <ids>  --test-decoders <gzfile>

options.name: --dump-storage
options.description: <dir>  --name-scan  --typemap  --block-map  --block-dump <0xCLASS>

options.name: --decode-blocks
options.description: --search-global <text>  --hex-search <hex>  --chunk-dump <idx>:<off>:<len>

options.name: --block-scan
options.description: --grep-inspect <ids>
